notes.title: Hotfix for alphabet and missing word
notes.content:
A bug snuck into the previous build that made alphabet level 2 and missing word level 4 unsolvable. This has now been fixed! 

Tests have been added for this case so it should be much harder for bugs like this to occur in the future

notes.title: New Public Beta Branch - 4 New Levels - Blackout Curtain
notes.content: [h2]Blackout Curtain[/h2][p]The public beta branch is out for You Are The Code! 4 new levels in a new folder, "blackout_curtain/", are awaiting your feedback. Save data is stored separately from the main game.[/p][p][/p][h2]Joining The Beta[/h2][p]In your steam library, right click You Are The Code -> properties -> click the "betas" tab -> beta participation -> "beta ..."[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix: Fixes Gems Getting Deleted
notes.content: [p]A hotfix has been released to address a bug that caused players to lose gems, and therefore unable to progress. If this happened to you, your save should automatically fix itself.[/p]
